usedFor: Gumlet hosts videos, and Conversion Chats sends a message when a “New Video Asset” arrives, through “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Video Asset” in Gumlet, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new video in a chosen collection prompts a message built from a saved template.

watchOut: “New Video Asset” is polling, so “Send Template Message” goes out after a scheduled check.
